verdict.rationale: Brevo documents an API capability to export raw, unaggregated transactional event data, which is the closest first-party evidence of reading engagement events programmatically. That export is limited to the past 7 days and to transactional email. Nothing shows a per-contact lookup or campaign-level sent, opened and clicked history. Webhooks push events rather than read history, and the segment filters are a UI feature, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: a documented per-contact engagement or activity endpoint, explicit sent/opened/clicked fields, coverage of marketing campaigns beyond transactional email, history beyond 7 days, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact

citations.quote: Export raw data of all transactional events from the past 7 days. Generate reports with unaggregated data for analytics.
